name: Halal SIP AI Dashboard End-to-End User Journey
description: Validates the full user journey: metrics inspection, transaction entry, Shariah compliance status, and evidence citations in the local Streamlit UI.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Halal SIP AI dashboard homepage
Assert that 'Halal SIP AI' header and 'Open, Local-First, Zero-Cost' subtitle are visibly rendered
Assert that Portfolio Value, Total Invested, Total Return %, and Annualized XIRR metric cards are present and populated with non-zero currency values
Click on the '💼 Portfolio & Ledger' tab
Assert that the transaction history table displays historical SIP transactions with dates, units, and NAVs
Fill out the transaction form with Type 'SIP', Amount 2000, and click 'Record Transaction'
Assert that a success confirmation appears and the ledger refreshes
Click on the '⚖️ Shariah & Governance' tab
Assert that 'Zero Prohibited Sector Violations Detected' success banner is visible
Assert that the Dividend Purification Calculator is interactive and displays calculated charity deduction
Click on the '🤖 Local AI Assistant' tab
Assert that evidence-based RAG UI is accessible and warns gracefully if local Ollama daemon is offline without crashing financial calculations
